title: SOH Estimator (Capacity-Based)
text: 基于容量衰减的健康状态估计器，输入 1 路、输出 1 路；按 {Algorithm data type} 指定用于选择模块算法数据类型的选项 Inherit:；{Cell capacity when battery is new, AH_new, (A*Hr)} 指定电池全新时的单体容量、{Cell capacity at end of life, AH_eol, (A*Hr)} 指定寿命终止时的单体容量，按实例取值。

ports.name: SOH
ports.summary: 电池的健康状态 scalar | vector

params.name: Cell capacity when battery is new, AH_new, (A*Hr)
params.values: 电池全新时的单体容量 27 (default) | nonnegative scalar

params.name: Cell capacity at end of life, AH_eol, (A*Hr)
params.values: 寿命终止时的单体容量 21.6 (default) | nonnegative scalar

params.name: Algorithm data type
params.values: 用于选择模块算法数据类型的选项 Inherit: auto (default) | double | single |
